query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Audit analytics and search performance for a website, inspect and modify its source repository, create pull requests with SEO, tracking, caching, routing, and accessibility fixes, and investigate hosting/deployment state.
query_ground_truth.query: list my Cloudflare DNS records and zones to verify the deployment setup
query_ground_truth.rationale: Investigating hosting and deployment state requires checking Cloudflare zones and DNS configuration.

request.query: list my Cloudflare DNS records and zones to verify the deployment setup

results.use_case: list my Cloudflare DNS records and zones to verify the deployment setup
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if zone identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Discover the target zone using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES (match the zone name and capture the zone identifier).
[Optional (if the zone does not exist)] [Prerequisite]: Create the zone using CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_ZONE (requires an account identifier available from prior setup/config).
[Required] [Step]: Enumerate/search records using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS (filter by name/type and paginate until all pages processed).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: From results, capture exact record identifier(s) and confirm whether intent is create vs update vs delete before any write.
[Optional (if adding records)] [Step]: Create record(s) using CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD (use zone_identifier).
[Optional (if modifying an existing record)] [Step]: Update record using CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD (use zone_identifier + record identifier; change only intended fields).
[Optional (if delete requested or replace is safer)] [Step]: Delete record using CLOUDFLARE_DELETE_DNS_RECORD, then (if replacing) recreate via CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD.
[Optional (for verification after changes)] [Next Step]: Re-list the affected name/type using CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS to confirm final state.

[Fallback (if authorization fails or data.success=false)] [Fallback]: Re-run reads with CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES and CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_DNS_RECORDS; perform creates/deletes with CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD / CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_DELETE_DNS_RECORD (for updates, use delete+create).
known_pitfalls: [CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] Results are under data.result with pagination in data.result_info (page/per_page/total_pages).
[CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS] Uses zone_id while write tools use zone_identifier; mixing them can cause request/validation failures.
[CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD] Requires both zone_identifier and the record identifier; record name/value alone is insufficient.
[CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES] Can fail with HTTP 403 even when a connection exists; use CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_LIST_ZONES for discovery.
[CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY_CREATE_DNS_RECORD] Requires zone_id plus record fields; omitting zone_id triggers input validation errors.

CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES.description: Lists, searches, sorts, and filters zones in the authenticated account. Use `page`/`per_page` to paginate; check `result_info.total_pages` in the response to iterate all pages. Does not return DNS records — extract `zone_id` from results before passing to zone-scoped tools (DNS, firewall, etc.). Only zones delegated to Cloudflare nameservers appear; empty results indicate scope or delegation constraints, not errors.

name.description: A domain name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend and refine the search.

match.description: Whether to match all search requirements or at least one (any).

name.description: An account Name. Optional filter operators can be provided to extend and refine the search

account.description: Filter zones by account ID and/or account name.

CLOUDFLARE_LIST_DNS_RECORDS.description: Tool to list and search DNS records in a Cloudflare zone. Use when you need to find existing DNS record IDs for update or delete operations, especially after a "record already exists" error during creation. Returns matching records with their IDs, names, types, content, and other properties.

name.description: Filter by exact DNS record name (FQDN). Use this to find records matching a specific hostname.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Start at 1.

type.description: Filter by DNS record type. Specify the exact record type to narrow results.

match.description: Filter matching logic: 'all' requires all filters to match (AND logic), 'any' requires at least one filter to match (OR logic). Defaults to 'all'.

content.description: Filter by exact DNS record content/value. Use this to find records pointing to a specific IP or target.

proxied.description: Filter by proxy status. Set to true for proxied records, false for DNS-only records.

zone_id.description: Zone identifier (UUID) to list DNS records from

per_page.description: Number of records per page (1-5000000). Defaults to 100. Use lower values for faster responses.

name_contains.description: Filter by DNS record names containing this substring. Useful for partial matching.

comment_contains.description: Filter by comments containing this substring.

content_contains.description: Filter by DNS record content containing this substring.

CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_DNS_RECORD.description: Tool to create a new DNS record within a specific zone. Requires write privileges and makes live changes to the zone. Use after obtaining the zone ID via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES to programmatically add DNS entries.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; minimum 1. Use 1 for automatic TTL

data.description: Additional data object for record types like SRV, LOC, or CAA

name.description: DNS record name (e.g., example.com or www.example.com)

tags.description: List of tags to associate with the record

comment.description: Human-readable comment for the DNS record

content.description: DNS record content (e.g., IP for A records)

proxied.description: Whether the record is receiving Cloudflare performance and security benefits

priority.description: Priority for MX, SRV, and URI records; required for those types

zone_identifier.description: Zone identifier (UUID) where the DNS record will be created

CLOUDFLARE_UPDATE_DNS_RECORD.description: Tool to update an existing DNS record within a specific zone. Use after confirming both zone and record identifiers; only provided fields are modified. Updates to records used by active tunnels take effect immediately and can disrupt live traffic.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; use 1 for 'automatic' TTL

data.description: Additional record-specific data for LOC, SRV, and CAA records

content.description: DNS record content (e.g., IP address for A records)

proxied.description: Whether the record is receiving Cloudflare's benefits

priority.description: Priority for MX, SRV, and URI records; required for these record types

zone_identifier.description: Zone identifier (UUID) of the DNS record to update

CLOUDFLARE_DELETE_DNS_RECORD.description: Tool to delete a DNS record within a specific zone. Deletion is immediate and irreversible. Use only after confirming both zone and record IDs. Requires write privileges on the zone. Example: "Delete DNS record 372e6795... from zone 023e105f4ecef..."

identifier.description: Identifier of the DNS record to delete (e.g., '372e67954025e0ba6aaa6d586b9e0b59').

CLOUDFLARE_CREATE_ZONE.description: Creates a new DNS zone (domain) in Cloudflare. A zone represents a domain and its DNS records. Use this when adding a new domain to manage with Cloudflare. Requires account ID (obtainable via LIST_ACCOUNTS). The zone will be in 'pending' status until nameservers are updated at the domain registrar.

name.description: The domain name for the new zone

type.description: Zone setup mode: 'full' (DNS hosted by Cloudflare), 'partial' (CNAME setup), or 'secondary' (secondary DNS)

id.description: Account identifier under which to create the zone

account.description: Container for account ID. If not provided, the zone will be created under the default account associated with the API credentials. Must be structured as `{'id': '<account_id>'}` where `id` is obtained via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ACCOUNTS.

jump_start.description: Auto-import existing DNS records from the domain. Ignored for partial zones.
